prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: FoodJury mascot exploration board for an existing mobile app that compares 2–5 food options and uses a playful judge to choose one based on Fun, Healthy, Fit, or Quick goals.
Create a beautiful art-directed character concept sheet, landscape format, roughly 3:2. Warm ivory paper background. One very large hero character on the left two-thirds, two smaller versions of the SAME character on the right, thinking at top and celebrating at bottom. Ample negative space. Tiny typographic label top left and pose labels in neat sans serif, no other text. Original contemporary brand illustration, unusually appealing and expertly drawn. Simple silhouette and expressive readable face that works at 48 pixels. The judge is witty, fair, food-loving and approachable, never punitive or moralizing. A polished consumer app identity aimed at adults; expressive without being childish. Keep props minimal. No photorealistic materials, woodgrain, fine wig curls, rendering noise, complex clothing folds, or extraneous floating decorative icons. Do not imitate any existing mascot.
Text (verbatim): "A / THE GAVEL" at top left; "Thinking" and "Verdict!" beside small poses.
Subject: A radically simplified anthropomorphic judge's gavel. The wide rounded horizontal head IS the character's face with two deep navy oval eyes and asymmetrical eyebrows, and the short chubby handle IS its compact body. Tiny expressive arms and short feet; small ivory split collar suggests judicial authority without a wig or an elaborate robe. One arm gestures invitingly. The body geometry must clearly read as a friendly T-shaped gavel, not a wooden barrel. No handheld second gavel.
Style: Exceptional clean flat 2D illustration with deep navy outer contour of consistent medium thickness, rounded geometric shapes, orange dominant and warm cream accents. A single flat darker orange area can give depth; no gradients. Strongly designed eye shape and knowing half-smile. Slightly retro but crisp contemporary app branding.
Small poses preserve exactly the same character proportions: thinking with one hand at chin and one raised eyebrow; celebrating with both arms out and smile.

Warm cream face, exactly three broad pleats at crown, tiny deep navy dot eyes with expressive eyebrows, small off-center smile, very short legs. A simplified deep navy cropped judge robe wraps the bottom third with a two-tab ivory collar; tiny orange mitt hands. The welcoming hero holds one small orange simplified gavel in one hand. Its large plump dumpling head and navy robe create a highly recognizable silhouette.
Style: Sophisticated minimal 2D food brand character; softly rounded bold shapes, selective dark outlines, totally flat colors with a single understated shadow shape. Cream, deep navy, brand orange. Small poses preserve identity: thinking with gavel resting down and eyebrow raised; celebrating with delighted closed-eye smile and gavel slightly raised.

Subject: A clever warm orange fox as an approachable food judge. Very compact seated body and oversized but sophisticated head. Two broad triangular ears, cream lower face and dark navy oval nose, relaxed expressive narrow eyes and one raised eyebrow. A short deep navy judicial cape with tiny cream split collar, one chunky orange tail wraps around body. Holds a small simple gavel down at side. No wig. Build a distinct, memorable face from just a few shapes, with a smart amused expression rather than generic cute eyes.

Small poses preserve identity: thoughtful chin-rest pose with tail tucked; celebrating with ears perked and proud closed-eye smile.
